entries.category_description: Admission to shows, theatres, circuses, fairs, amusement parks, concerts, museums, zoos, cinemas, exhibitions and similar cultural events and facilities
entries.code_description: Performing arts event production and presentation services
entries.comment:
Institutions who are recognised by the government and whose revenues are only used to cover their operational costs according to article 44, § 2, 7° and 9° of the Belgian VAT Code

The exemption only applies to 90.02.11, 90.04, 91.02.10, 91.03.10, 91.04.11 in that context.

entries.category_description: Admission to shows, theatres, circuses, fairs, amusement parks, concerts, museums, zoos, cinemas, exhibitions and similar cultural events and facilities
entries.code_description: Performing arts event production and presentation services
entries.comment:
Admission to and use of cultural and entertainment facilities according to Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category XXVIII with the exception of the 
- right to use automatic entertainment devices
- putting at disposal of movable goods.

If the VAT exemption does not apply and provided that the services are covered by said category XXVIII, the reduced rate applies to 90.04, 91.02.10, 91.03.10, 91.04.11, 93.2

entries.category_description: Admission to shows, theatres, circuses, fairs, amusement parks, concerts, museums, zoos, cinemas, exhibitions and similar cultural events and facilities
entries.code_description: Performing arts event production and presentation services
entries.comment: Including entrance fees for rides in amusement parks. Usually exempted or out of the scope of VAT if organized by non-profit making organizations or public bodies.

entries.category_description: Admission to shows, theatres, circuses, fairs, amusement parks, concerts, museums, zoos, cinemas, exhibitions and similar cultural events and facilities
entries.code_description: Performing arts event production and presentation services
entries.comment: Admission to shows, theatres, circuses, concerts, operas, ballets and similar performances are subject to 6 % VAT. The reduced rate also applies to admission to zoos. However, arrangement of public exhibitions in museums and supplies of items to such exhibitions are exempt if the museum is run by the public sector or is supported by the public sector. Admission to amusement parks and cinemas are subject to the standard VAT rate. Please see chapter 9 section 14 in the Swedish VAT Act.

entries.category_description: Admission to shows, theatres, circuses, fairs, amusement parks, concerts, museums, zoos, cinemas, exhibitions and similar cultural events and facilities
entries.code_description: Performing arts event production and presentation services
entries.comment: Production and performance of performing arts, operation of artistic venues – admission to theatrical performances, puppet theatre shows, opera, ballet, musicals, or other similar cultural performances, and services related to the operation of museums.
